title: Fix the shadowing bugs
hints: Every `{ }` block is a new scope. `x := ...` inside an `if` block always creates variables **in that block**, even if an outer `x` exists.
In `ParsePort`, the inner `port, err := strconv.Atoi(s)` creates a second `port` that disappears at the closing `}`. The outer `port` stays `8080`.
Inside the `if`, write `var err error` and change the line to `port, err = strconv.Atoi(s)` (plain `=`). Do the same with `f` in `Scale`.
